name: What are the common signs of a water leak behind a wall?

mainEntity.name: What are the common signs of a water leak behind a wall?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common signs of a hidden water leak include discoloration or staining on walls or ceilings, peeling paint or wallpaper, a musty or damp odor, warped or bubbling drywall, and an unexplained increase in your water bill. You might also notice soft spots on your walls or flooring near the affected area. It's crucial to address these signs promptly to prevent further damage and mold growth.
acceptedAnswer.description: Look for discoloration, peeling paint, musty odors, warped walls, or an unexplained high water bill. These indicate a hidden water leak.
